senses.gloss:
दभ् दभ् (connected with rt. दम्भ्,
q. v.), cl. 1. 5. P. दभति, दभ्नोति,
&c., to hurt, injure, destroy; to go; cl. 10. P.
दाभयति or दम्भयति, &c., to send, impel, order,
command; [cf. Gr. θάμβος, ἔταφον, τέθηπα; Old
Germ. tepyan or depyan.]

दभ, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. injuring, hurting; (अस्),
m. deception, deceiving, (only occurring in dat. case,
दभाय used for inf.; cf. अ-दभ, दम्भ,
दूडभ.)

दभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be hurt or injured,
to be deceived.

दाभ्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be disturbed or obstructed;
to be governed or ruled.

दभ्र, अस्, आ, अम्, little, small, deficient; (अस्), m.
the sea, ocean; (अम्), ind. a little, slightly.
—द-
भ्र-चेतस्, आस्, आस्, अस्, or दभ्र-बुद्धि, इस्, इस्,
इ, little-minded, weak-minded.

दाभी दाभी, f. (fr. rt. दभ्?), Ved. hurt-
ing, injuring (?).
